tool_action.public_message: Hotel rent isn't the gap — build cost is. Light blue houses are $50; yellow are $150. Both light blues for Ventnor, no cash. $300 the other way just funds your houses and strips mine.

Never include Park Place. p1 remains 2/3 orange with NY unowned.
